Subject: MAP kickoff: hosting mode + region constraints

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked Redwood’s latency profile. Procurement asked that we lock the deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and the region preference early so they can estimate costs and security reviews.

Can you share a mutual action plan (high level milestones + owners) and a proposed evaluation plan so we can get legal/procurement moving? Our main constraints:
- US-only PHI handling (HIPAA) for a POC subset (patient summaries)
- SLA expectations: 99.9% for API availability during business hours
- Preferred region: us-west but open to east if it simplifies infra

Target: we need a go/no-go from procurement by 2026-07-21 to keep our quarter timeline.

I attached a short spreadsheet with our internal procurement deadlines.

Thanks,
Claire
VP Product, NexaHealth

Claire — thanks, that procurement timeline is helpful. Forwarding a drafted MAP and a proposed evaluation plan for the POC subset.

High level proposal (summary):
- Phase 0 (this week): confirm data residency & required E2E encryption (owner: Nexa + Redwood security)
- Phase 1 (eval, 2 weeks): run POC on Hosted Redwood API with HIPAA controls enabled; run perf tests (latency/throughput) in us-west (owner: Nexa engineering, Redwood SE)
- Gate A: if prefix-keyed latency and KV cache meet SLOs and no data residency blockers, move to Dedicated reserved capacity for production (owner: Nexa ops, Redwood infra)
- Gate B: if procurement/policy requires full tenant isolation + on-prem keying, schedule Private deployment (owner: Nexa infra, Redwood enterprise eng)

Questions / asks for your procurement team:
1) Are there minimum contract windows (term commitments) that will rule out Hosted?
2) Any explicit restrictions on KMS providers or HSM usage?
3) Can procurement accept an initial hosted trial with written data processing addendum while they complete the procurement review?

I attached a draft MAP (Redwood-MAP-draft.pdf) with owners and proposed dates. Suggested next step: a 30-min decision call Jul 16 to confirm Gate definitions and meeting cadence.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Claire / Dylan — quick technical notes from Soojin (solutions):

- For the POC, my recommendation is: try Hosted first with the HIPAA DPA and customer-managed key (we can integrate common KMS providers). Hosted lets you test performance quickly without procurement lock-in. If we hit a compliance/legal block, we have two paths: Dedicated (same cloud region, reserved GPUs) or Private (VPC connector / on-prem if required).
- Gating metrics for moving off Hosted: sustained 95th percentile latency under 300ms for the target prompts and no outstanding audit evidence requests. If either fails, we propose a 2-week mitigation sprint to tune batching/quantization; if still unmet, transition to Dedicated.
- Region note: us-west preferred; we can provision a us-east fallback for DR but that adds cross-region egress and will appear in cost estimates.

Action items I can own: load test profile, sampling prompts, and quantization recommendation for the POC.

Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
